notes: Adds a bounded post-Business optional intelligence-enrichment step using deterministic server-owned question definitions.
Every question is skippable; skip progress never creates fake Business Context and optional enrichment must never trap the owner from reaching Today.

Answered questions reuse the existing BusinessContextEntry as owner-confirmed authoritative context; BusinessQuestionProgress stores only answered/skipped workflow state and catalogue/question identity.
Question selection supports all eight initial category families plus Generic fallback, suppresses reliably known context, returns at most five useful questions and never pads with filler.
A catalogue version change alone never re-asks a skipped question; future material-value-triggered re-asking remains outside VS-17.
The generic customer-groups question uses the existing canonical Business Context key customers so known customer context is not duplicated under a synonymous storage key.
The approved Atlas visual system, BrandMark boundary, existing Business creation/provenance semantics, authentication and Business isolation are preserved.
The direct VS-15 certified dependency is retained as required by the integrated MVP acceptance boundary, in addition to VS-16.
Implementation head 6f67fe53d9a71edd850df12a0af26096fcceba1e passed CI run 31344152550, Security baseline run 31344152567 and Product Intake run 31344152547.

CI run 31344152550 includes authentic Expo Web verification at 390×844 and 768×1024 for VS-17 plus the existing VS-15 Context and VS-16 discovery regression journeys; evidence is retained in artifact 9046799968 (sha256:911e2ff1d5949e87b9d2850fda528a9b42a9a750d1025090c10f1982c35c768d).
No Knowledge Pack Schema v2, category opportunity engine, release, deployment or production enablement is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the VS-17 written design after approving the skippable deterministic catalogue, tap-first one-question flow, post-Business sequence, category coverage and skip suppression semantics.
VS-17 introduces no policy waiver; it minimizes owner data collection, keeps every enrichment question optional and preserves existing Business isolation/privacy boundaries.
Product Owner approved the written VS-17 design and instructed work to continue. Release and production remain unauthorized.
